title: Beyond Bias Scores: Answerability Confounds in Activation Steering with Gradient-Constrained Direction Design (GCD)
abstract: arXiv:2610.17641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bias scores in language-model evaluations often conflate what a model prefers with whether it answers at all. We identify this confound in \textsc{BBQ}, whose ambiguous score factorizes into answerability and signed preference. Across 11 categories, 28,}824 items, and five models, contrastive steering lowers the signed ambiguous score in 11/11 categories but lowers the signed disambiguated preference score in only 8/11. Across 99 configurations, the answerability channel exceeds half of the observed score change in 17\% and accounts for the entire change in 11%. In a six-category disambiguated evaluation, 20.8\% of 1,500 items flip to the unknown option, where abstention is incorrect; \textsc{StereoSet} shows no analogous answer-rate shift. The effect reflects selection and near-orthogonality between the contrastive and preference-gradient directions. translated_title: 超越偏见分数：激活引导中的可回答性混淆因素与梯度约束方向设计（GCD）
translated_abstract: 语言模型评估中的偏见分数常常将模型的偏好与模型是否作答混为一谈。我们在 BBQ 基准中识别出这一混淆因素，其歧义分数可分解为可回答性与带符号偏好两个成分。在涵盖 11 个类别、28,824 个条目和 5 个模型的实验中，对比引导（contrastive steering）在 11/11 个类别中都降低了带符号的歧义分数，但仅在 8/11 个类别中降低了带符号的消歧偏好分数。在 99 种配置中，可回答性通道在 17% 的情况下超过观测分数变化的一半，并在 11% 的情况下解释了全部变化。在一项涵盖六个类别的消歧评估中，1,500 个条目中有 20.8% 翻转为“未知”选项，而在此类情况下弃权是错误的；StereoSet 则未表现出类似的作答率变化。该效应反映了对比方向与偏好梯度方向之间的选择性以及二者近似正交的特性。我们提出了梯度约束方向设计（GCD），这是一种基于选项梯度的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示激活引导在降低偏见分数时实际混淆了“模型是否作答”与“模型的偏好倾向”两个因素，并据此提出梯度约束方向设计（GCD），以便在保持模型作答能力不变的前提下精准地调整模型的偏见偏好。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that bias-score reductions from activation steering are confounded by answerability effects—whether the model answers at all rather than what it prefers—and proposes Gradient-Constrained Direction Design (GCD) to steer model preferences precisely while preserving answerability.
